rows.why: F04 board 12 of 12 — the same three-band repair that landed on the other eleven, now that the read shows this board is structurally identical to them and that the hold's premise was wrong. The Footer 2430:21397 is 280x44 at (3256,21866), INSIDE a board ending 21946 — not hanging 100px below it as the stale detector row claimed. Its children carry the identical names and footer-relative offsets as board 1: 'Aa Fonts' 2838:12064 at rel (213,14) measuring 50x40, i.e. WRAPPED onto two lines exactly like 144:2's was. Moving it to rel x209 gives the label the run it needs; paired with the resize below.

F04 board 12 — un-wrap 'Aa Fonts'. The label measures ~53px at 13/Regular against a 50px box, which is why it broke to two lines and grew to 40px tall. 58 gives it one line, matching the fix applied to the other eleven boards.

F04 board 12 — restore note/formats to its created width. This is the root cause the f-missed author traced: plans/media-05-node-edits.json created these at width 248, and a later <=60px overprint fixer narrowed this one to 185 to clear its horizontal overlap with the wrapped 'Aa Fonts'. Narrowing bought a fifth line and deepened the VERTICAL collision it was not measuring — 185x100 here, overlapping note/where-it-lives at 21956-21996 completely. A box cannot get taller when it gets wider, so 5 lines at 185 is at most 4 lines at 248.

F04 board 12 — reseat note/where-it-lives below the restored formats block. rel y 90 -> 132, the same offset the other eleven boards took. move writes PARENT-relative y and the parent Footer sits at abs 21866, so 132 puts it at abs 21998, clear of note/formats which ends at rel 124 once it is 248 wide.

F24 — the last unresolved placeholder, now safe to write. It was held because a button label is the one container sized to its own text and 1339:7162's box was unknown, so +6 characters was a guess. The read settles it: the button is the CTA frame 1339:7169, 392x40 at (1944,93081) — a fixed 392px, not a hug. 'Look at Bella Cucina' sets to roughly 130px at 13px, well inside it. The site name is not invented either: the sibling headline 1339:7167 on this same card already reads 'Bella Cucina is ready for you to look at', landed earlier in this arc, and D-H-31 measured 'Bella Cucina' across all sixteen canonical S5.5 boards.
